## run_m

```{r}
profvis::profvis({
  binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
    mode = "replay",
    policy = "off",
    
    data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_Exp2,
    id = 1,
    eta = c(0.321, 0.765),
    n_params = 2, 
    n_trials = 360,
    
    initial_value = 100,
    threshold = 1,
    epsilon = NA,
    lambda = 0.1,
    pi = 0.01,
    tau = 0.5
  )
})
```


## cmpfun

```{r}
obj_func <- function(params){
  binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
    mode = "replay",
    policy = "on",
    
    data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_Exp2,
    id = 1,
    eta = c(0.1, 0.8),
    n_params = 2, 
    n_trials = 360,
    
    initial_value = 100,
    threshold = 1,
    epsilon = NA,
    lambda = 0.1,
    pi = 0.01,
    tau = 0.5
  )
  
  return(binaryRL.res$ll)
}

original_obj_func <- obj_func
compiled_obj_func <- compiler::cmpfun(obj_func)

microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  "original" = { original_obj_func() },
  "compiled" = { compiled_obj_func() },
  times = 50
)
```

```{r}
obj_func <- function(params){
  binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
    mode = "replay",
    policy = "on",
    
    data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_Exp2,
    id = 1,
    eta = c(params[1], params[2]),
    n_params = 2, 
    n_trials = 360,
    
    initial_value = 100,
    threshold = 1,
    epsilon = NA,
    lambda = 0.1,
    pi = 0.01,
    tau = 0.5
  )
  
  return(binaryRL.res$ll)
}

obj_func <- compiler::cmpfun(obj_func)

result <- GA::ga(
  type = "real-valued",
  fitness = function(x) -obj_func(x),
  popSize = 50,
  lower = c(0, 0),
  upper = c(1, 1),
  maxiter = 10,
  monitor = TRUE,
  parallel = TRUE
)
```
